body.name: fixTok
body.def: A token \(\varphi=(\tau,s,W_j,D,D',j,k)\) records the current one-district task, its context, the next vertex in the fixed lexicographically least valid sequence for the prescribed complement \(D'\setminus D\), the required district \(D\), its proper ambient district \(D'\), the prefix index \(j\), and the unique kernel label \(k\).
